children: Bagchi tenders his resignation from ICICI Prudential Life with effect from the close of business on October 13

ICICI Prudential Life Insurance has appointed Siddhartha Mishra as its Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer for a five-year term, following the resignation of Anup Bagchi, who is set to join HDFC Bank as its MD and CEO.

Mishra will take charge from October 14, 2026, or the date of approval from the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (Irdai), whichever is later, according to the company's exchange filing on Friday.

He has also been appointed as an additional director of the insurer. Mishra currently heads digital channels and partnerships, voice channel, customer service, non-resident Indian (NRI) and international financial institutions and government (IFIG) groups at ICICI Bank. He has more than 26 years of experience in banking.
Mishra holds a bachelor's degree in science and a postgraduate diploma in management, specialising in finance, from Utkal University, Bhubaneswar.
Bagchi To Take Over At HDFC Bank
Bagchi tendered his resignation from ICICI Prudential Life with effect from the close of business on October 13, citing plans to pursue a new career opportunity outside the organisation.

His move follows HDFC Bank's appointment of Bagchi as its MD and CEO for a three-year term. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved his appointment and remuneration on October 1, with his term scheduled to begin on October 27.
HDFC Bank's board has appointed Bagchi as an additional director with effect from October 2, subject to shareholder approval under the Companies Act, 2013.

Bagchi has been associated with the ICICI Group since 1992 and has held leadership roles across treasury, retail and wholesale banking, investment banking and digital financial services. He previously served as MD and CEO of ICICI Securities and as executive director at ICICI Bank.
He has been MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life since June 2023.
